newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Gold starts weaker in disappointed Europe. [CORRECTED 08:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Gold starts weaker in disappointed Europe. [CORRECTED 08:45 GMT]

text.p: Gold opened lower by $1.75 in Zurich as the market showed disappointment that a brief rise in European trading the day before had faded again before Monday's close.
Gold started at $318.85/319.25 against a London close at $320.60/321.10.
Trader saw the range stuck at $317/322 for the next few days at least after the failure of the break to higher levels on Monday on the back of some professional buying.
"We were hoping we might be able to get established at around $322/323 but it didn't happen and the market is disappointed," one Zurich trader said.
Silver was also easier at $4.25/4.27, four cents down from Monday's close and at the bottom of a range of $4.25/4.35.
"This is the range now that we have turned from the levels $4.30/4.40," one trader said.
Platinum was down $4.50 at $401.00/405.00 (corrects asking price from $414.00) in an uncertain market with low liquidity and wide spreads.
Palladium firmed $5.50 from London close to $171.00/175.00.
